annotations.title: Check a signed copy or a Trust Ledger Token

description: Check the two signatures on a Trust Ledger Token (tlt2. or tlt. form, or its JTI) against Trooth's own token ledger. A Trust Ledger Token is a signed token a company issues through Trooth about its own declared claims: the company signs the claims and Trooth signs the event of issuing it. Returns valid, invalid (a signature does not check out), expired or revoked, or unclaimed when no token matches; Trooth's signature covers the signing event, not the claim bytes and not the truth of the claims. With url in place of token, it checks a page Semanto signs against its signed copy: matches, differs or not signed, with the version, the signer and the proof address. It takes token or url, one of the two.

hash.description: With url: the sha256: digest of the markdown the caller was served, compared in place of a fetch.

token.description: A Trust Ledger Token (tlt2. or tlt. form) or its JTI.

url.description: A page Semanto signs (https), to check it against its signed copy.
